paragraphs.text: When a supermarket opens on the edge of a town, the small shops in the centre often close within a few years. Many people see this as the natural result of competition, and they are partly right: supermarkets are usually cheaper and more convenient.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: But I believe the loss is greater than the price of a loaf of bread. A street of independent shops keeps people walking in the town centre, and those people also visit cafés, libraries and banks. When the shops go, the whole centre begins to empty.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Local councils have tried to help by lowering business rates for small shops. This is welcome, although in my experience the effect has been modest, because rent rather than tax is usually the heaviest cost.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Shoppers, too, have a part to play. Nobody should feel guilty for buying cheaper goods, but choosing a local shop for a few items each week costs little and matters more than most people realise.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: they are partly right: supermarkets are usually cheaper and more convenient
items.prompt: The writer accepts that supermarkets are often cheaper than small shops.

explanation.en: “they are partly right: supermarkets are usually cheaper” — the writer agrees with this part: supermarkets are cheaper → YES.
explanation.kk: «they are partly right: supermarkets are usually cheaper» — автор осы бөлігімен келіседі: супермаркет арзанырақ → YES.
explanation.ru: «they are partly right: supermarkets are usually cheaper» — автор соглашается с этой частью: супермаркеты дешевле → YES.

items.quote: When the shops go, the whole centre begins to empty
items.prompt: The writer thinks the closure of small shops affects only their owners.

explanation.en: In the writer’s view, without the shops people stop visiting cafés, libraries and banks: “the whole centre begins to empty”. Not only the owners suffer → NO.
explanation.kk: Автордың пікірінше, дүкен жабылса, адамдар кафеге, кітапханаға, банкке де бармай қалады: «the whole centre begins to empty». Тек иелері ғана зардап шекпейді → NO.
explanation.ru: По мнению автора, без магазинов люди перестают ходить в кафе, библиотеки и банки: «the whole centre begins to empty». Страдают не только владельцы → NO.

items.quote: in my experience the effect has been modest
items.prompt: The writer believes lower business rates have solved the problems of small shops.

explanation.en: “the effect has been modest, because rent rather than tax is usually the heaviest cost” — a small effect, the main problem remains → NO.
explanation.kk: «the effect has been modest, because rent rather than tax is usually the heaviest cost» — әсері шамалы, негізгі мәселе шешілмеген → NO.
explanation.ru: «the effect has been modest, because rent rather than tax is usually the heaviest cost» — эффект скромный, главная проблема осталась → NO.

items.quote: rent rather than tax is usually the heaviest cost
items.prompt: The writer thinks councils should limit the rents that landlords charge.

explanation.en: The writer calls rent the heaviest cost but does not say what councils should do about it. “Rents should be limited” would be our conclusion, not the writer’s → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Автор жалдау ақысын ең ауыр шығын дейді, бірақ жергілікті әкімдіктер онымен не істеуі керегін айтпайды. «Жалдау ақысын шектеу керек» деген қорытынды — біздікі, автордікі емес → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Автор называет аренду самой большой статьёй расходов, но не говорит, что с ней должны делать советы. Вывод «надо ограничить аренду» — наш, не авторский → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: choosing a local shop for a few items each week costs little and matters more than most people realise
items.prompt: The writer suggests that regularly buying a few items in local shops is worthwhile.

explanation.en: “choosing a local shop for a few items each week costs little and matters more than most people realise” — the writer recommends it → YES.
explanation.kk: «choosing a local shop for a few items each week costs little and matters more than most people realise» — автор мұны істеуді ұсынады → YES.
explanation.ru: «choosing a local shop for a few items each week costs little and matters more than most people realise» — автор советует это делать → YES.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Do the following statements agree with the claims of the writer in the reading passage? Write YES if the statement agrees with the claims of the writer, NO if the statement contradicts the claims of the writer, or NOT GIVEN if it is impossible to say what the writer thinks about this.
